alignments.note: Substantival demonstrative expanded with a generic noun; rule 17 heads on *These*.
Dative pronoun with its case preposition (rule 21).
Inflected verb with its English subject; head on the lexical verb (rule 9).
No conjunction governs the clause, so the infinitival *to* is an ordinary rule 7 helper on its verb (rule 61).

ἐν τάχει rendered by the single word *shortly*, so the pair is one unit under rule 94. Rule 39's test keeps it `aligned` rather than `noncompositional`, *short-* answering to τάχει; rule 93's variant reading — that the adverbial sense is the noun's alone and ἐν pleonastic under rule 34 — is defensible, but the bare dative noun does not spell *shortly* by itself. Variant SBLGNT.1TI.3.14.v003 is underdetermined with the base among the permitted readings (rule 12).
